thought.text: Server, Vite, and migrations all check out. Now let me verify the actual application content, routes, and the missing-component claim.

reasoning_content:
All three migration batches have been executed (Laravel batches multiple tables into a single migration file). The main page returns HTTP 200 with Inertia content, and Vite is serving the modules.

So, let's verify the following next:
1. Whether the page content actually contains the interactive garden map (the application)
2. Whether the .env file has APP_KEY
3. Whether the external sensor data API (opendata.wuerzburg.de) is reachable
4. Whether the missing Vue components issue exists (upstream source code defect)
5. The main routes

Let me take a look at the contents of the page and the routes.
